chunks: "Beware of asking people, for it is the humiliation of this world, a poverty that you hasten for yourselves, and a long reckoning on the Day of Judgment."

key_terms.إِيَّاكُمْ: beware; a strong warning and caution
key_terms.اَلنَّاسِ: people; human beings from whom one seeks

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about asking people for help?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام warns against asking people, portraying it as a source of humiliation in worldly life. He also describes it as a form of poverty brought forward upon oneself and a cause of lengthy reckoning on the Day of Judgment.
